repairs.behavior: Propagate explicit canonical-body, operation remaining raw bytes and wall-time quotas through FMP, HTML, listing, opt-in payload and supervised result serialization; remove immutable16MiB/10MiB/2MiB/24MiB/60s post-allocation permissions. Default provider raw limit remains only if neither operation nor session allocates a quota.
repairs.kept: single existing BatchBudget byte/request counters, per-request canonical-body quota, actual wall deadline, supervisor termination+cleanup, monetary quota, identity/period/as-of/host/MIME/hash checks

repairs.behavior: Verify immutable TXT/header/identity/period independently; missing, malformed or unreadable non-authoritative sidecar may only yield legacy_unverified with diagnostic. Parsed explicit conflicting identities, periods, hashes/sizes or URL pins remain genuine refusal; no new fetch, translation, raw or bad-note rewrite. Strict public receipt parser still rejects malformed metadata.
repairs.kept: No provenance fabricated and no legacy original upgraded to verified. Raw corruption/invalid UTF8/missing identity cannot be made valid by a bad note.

public_interfaces.operation_quota: earnings-transcript-request/1 max_body_bytes/max_response_bytes positive int and timeout_seconds positive int; no immutable 10MiB or60s maximum
public_interfaces.session_quota: _BudgetSession.remaining_response_bytes reads the SAME BatchBudget.response_bytes_left; no second accounting counter
public_interfaces.runtime_wire: result read allocation is derived from declared body/raw/remaining budgets plus JSON representation upper bound, not old MAX_RESULT_BYTES; explicit read/worker deadlines and shape/type remain
public_interfaces.artifact: ArtifactVerdict.diagnostics tuple[str,...]; ReceiptError.observation only carries parsed optional sidecar for explicit-conflict checking
